metadata.title: Clicked like a potato with caffeine and somehow got 2 kills? Valorant aim is a glitch
metadata.description:
Me: smashing buttons like my life depends on it
Enemy: probably questioning their existence
How did I even tag 2? No clue but I’m riding this luck train

Hit like if your aim ever took a vacation mid-game!

Tap if your panic clicks ever surprise even YOU!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykill #funnygaming #shorts
